# Revealing conditions for antags
The following list provides revealing conditions for different antags you may see on the station
## Nukies
- Crew know what nukies are, but should not prepare for them. - Seeing the nukies. - Seeing someone that looks like a nukie. - Finding the nukie ship. - Pretty simple
## Everything else
- Nanotrasen knows about the other threats. If you suspect them being real, they might be.
## Stealth Items
- As an antagonist use your stealth items in a way that they wont get found. - If sec realises you have an implant / no-slips / another stealth item thats on you.
